The F1 isn't from one team or one dataset in the way that matters. The evaluation holds out five whole buildings, 31 units and 187 episodes, and nothing was tuned on them, so the number is measured on buildings the method never saw. The 95% interval on that F1 is 0.83 to 0.90, and across the five held-out buildings it ranged from 0.80 to 0.93, so it isn't carried by one easy site. What I'd concede is that all of it comes from a single estate in one climate, and we didn't test on a second estate or an external dataset, so transfer is genuinely unknown.

[[GIST]] held-out buildings, not one dataset
